narr: Multiple rounds of monsoonal thunderstorms occurred on August 7th through the 9th. A few severe thunderstorms produced high winds, while many others produced very heavy rain and flash flooding.
ev: More than 200 people were stranded at the Palm Springs Aerial Tramway as heavy rain in the San Jacinto Mountains and State Park caused impassible mudflows along the exit road from the valley station. Operations of Palm Springs said mud began flowing down east of the station onto the road. The flow appeared to be mostly mud, and not debris. Rainfall of 1.99 inches was measured at the Mt San Jacinto Peak RAWS site.
